Second joint operation in 2023 | “International Coalition” and SDF execute security operation in Deir Ezzor

Deir Ezzor province: SOHR activists have reported that a patrol of special forces of SDF, with aerial and ground support by the International Coalition, stormed Al-Basira town in eastern Deir Ezzor countryside, sieged a house and demanded its owner to surrender himself via speakers, coinciding with opening fire to warn civilians from approaching the area.

It is worth noting that this is the second joint security operation in 2023.

This come as part of the attempts by the International Coalition and SDF to pursue ISIS cells in NE of Syria.

Earlier today, clashes with light weapons took place after midnight, following an airdrop operation carried out by the international coalition forces and SDF security units in Al-Attal neighbourhood on the outskirts of Al-Shuhayl city, east of Deir Ezzor.

The units raided the house of an ISIS member, arresting him, while the troops withdrew towards the Omar oil field east of Deir Ezzor.

It is worth noting that the detainee was previously arrested and released on bail and tribal mediation, and is one of the most prominent ISIS members in Deir Ezzor.
